title: Detecting mild traumatic brain injury with MEG, normative modelling and machine learning
summary: Normative MEG modeling against 621 healthy participants produced deviation maps used by an SVM to distinguish 25 mTBI cases from 20 controls; theta-band deviations were discriminative.
